title: GrantTrace Configuration Schema
description: JSON Schema specification for GrantTrace v2.3.1-final authorization and mass-assignment auditing configuration.

$schema.description: URI pointing to this configuration schema

description.description: Optional human-readable description of this configuration environment

identities.description: Test identity credentials and roles (Owner, Visitor, and Anonymous)

parameter_values.description: Pre-configured valid path and query parameter values indexed by 'METHOD /path'

write_allowlist.description: List of PATCH operations permitted for active mass-assignment testing

readbacks.description: Independent GET readback mappings required for allowlisted PATCH operations

bola.description: Per-operation BOLA exploration policies and resource ID path mappings

id.description: Resource identifier associated with this identity

token.description: Bearer token or Authorization header value

parameters.description: Identity-bound path or query parameters (e.g. user_id)

auth_header_names.description: Names of custom headers carrying authentication credentials

method.description: HTTP method for readback, must be GET

path.description: Path template for the readback operation

consistency.description: Readback consistency guarantee ('strong' required for unmutated SECURE conclusion)

field_map.description: Mapping from PATCH payload field path to readback response field path

parameters.description: Readback path/query Parameter Objects consumed directly by the URL builder

parameter_values.description: Explicit parameter values for the readback request

snapshot_path.description: Root path inside readback response containing the resource state

ignore_readback_paths.description: Known volatile fields (e.g. updatedAt) to ignore during rollback verification

readback_delay.description: Delay in seconds between readback polling attempts

baseline_payload.description: Additional static payload fields merged into write requests

expected_public.description: Whether this operation is intended to be publicly accessible

resource_id_paths.description: JSON field paths containing trustworthy resource ownership identifiers
